entries.visual_role: structural wall shell / wall grid / facade base
entries.default_orientation_policy: use recipe or part-specific override before generic rx/rz
entries.host_requirement: must contact floor, foundation, adjacent wall, corner join, or declared shell grid
entries.valid_scale_behavior: uniform unless exported JSON proves non-uniform survives and is visually acceptable
failure_notes: do not present isolated wall panels as enclosed buildings
do not count relief/detail as enclosure unless it satisfies contact and closure
check corner closure and roof/top closure

entries.visual_role: cornice / trim / iris blade support / wall banding
entries.native_axis_status: requires recipe orientation for rings and bands
entries.default_orientation_policy: recipe first; part map only confirms dimensions
entries.host_requirement: must attach to wall, ring, frame, or shell layer
entries.valid_scale_behavior: uniform unless recipe explicitly proves otherwise
failure_notes: do not use as free-floating blade or loose trim
do not bypass airlock recipe when used in iris/vault/portal feature

entries.visual_role: radial iris / vault door / airlock aperture
entries.default_orientation_policy: never generate from part dimensions alone; load AIRLOCK_IRIS recipes first
entries.host_requirement: ring layers must close around center pivot and attach to declared wall/facade/frame
entries.valid_scale_behavior: uniform; recipe parameters control radius/panel count/depth
failure_notes: component ObjectIDs in part map do not define the airlock assembly
check ring closure and overlap direction

entries.visual_role: access route / skybridge / ramp / stairs / catwalk
entries.host_requirement: must contact endpoint landings and support/load path unless exact JSON proves exception
entries.valid_scale_behavior: uniform; repeat spacing from JSON recipe or part map extents
failure_notes: all modules in a route share the same path basis
run no-float and intent graph checks

entries.visual_role: vertical sign plane / wall-mounted city sign
entries.default_orientation_policy: rx=0; use side map N/S/E/W; do not apply generic rx=90 facade convention
entries.host_requirement: wall or facade attachment unless intentionally freestanding and supported
entries.valid_scale_behavior: uniform in generated builds unless exported JSON proves non-uniform survives
failure_notes: do not use non-uniform scaling without proof

entries.visual_role: dense dark city / Gotham skyscraper district
entries.host_requirement: towers must have wall shell/foundation/roof closure; rooftop details must attach to roof/plinth
entries.valid_scale_behavior: uniform unless current-build exported JSON proves otherwise
failure_notes: do not create decorative skyline without enclosure
do not lose wall-shell invariants between chats
AI Review bundle may validate design loop

rules: SET_CLASS_A/B/S are fixed colored beams that can compose volumetric cones/beacons.
